text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While passing near the dorms, I spotted 
Bamboo Memory and Mejiro Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you so much for helping me carry 
these books. It was truly a great help. 
Goodness, I seem to have borrowed far too 
many.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
This much is natural! If you're ever in 
trouble again, just let me know anytime!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer! Good morning!
choice_data_list: Helping others is admirable, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! I'm gonna push myself 
even harder today though~!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"After all, today... is '64 Good Deeds a 
Day' Day!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's how it was at first! And from 
there, double it every day: 2, 4, 8! 
...16! Uhh... 32? 32!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ummm, ummm, ummm... And then! 64 on the 
1st week! If I can clear this, it'll be so 
cool! Totally hype!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"W-Whoa! I'll be late if I don't hurry! 
Excuse me, I've gotta run!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Unable to stop her before she left, I 
watched her go with a feeling of deep 
concern.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And in the evening, I spotted Bamboo 
Memory out on the track.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, sorry for all the trouble, Bamboo! 
Thanks for helping me hand out 
refreshments to the juniors!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"No, no! I'm just happy I could be of help 
to you, Inari-senpai!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, reliable as ever. I've heard the 
rumors—you've been helping out left and 
right lately.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I know you've been looking out for me, but 
aren't you overworking yourself? Since 
it's you we're talking about, I'd gladly 
lend a hand!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...No! I really appreciate the thought, 
but this is something I wanna see through 
with my own strength!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—When I became head of the disciplinary 
committee, my dad told me something. About 
what it takes to uphold discipline.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you became head of the Disciplinary 
Committee! Well done! Alright, let me give 
you a piece of advice from my teaching 
experience.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text:
A person who upholds public morals has 
gotta be... absolutely, supremely cool, 
first and foremost!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text:
Anyone with enough guts can point out 
someone's wrongdoing. However, that alone 
won't make them truly mend their ways.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text:
That is why those who maintain discipline 
must first set an example for everyone 
else. A cool, admirable example that makes 
everyone want to follow in their 
footsteps!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I see...! If we do that, everyone will 
naturally uphold public morals!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Ever since then, whenever I came up with 
special training to be a good role model 
for everyone, I'd put it into action right 
away!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Early to bed, early to rise all year 
round," "Operation Squeaky Clean Toilet," 
"Chew your food properly campaign," and so 
on... And now, this "Double-Up Good Deed a 
Day Week"!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Inspired by a line from a drama I used to 
watch—'Always surpass the person you were 
yesterday!'—this is my strongest special 
training yet!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And out of our goal of 64 good deeds, 
Inari-senpai makes 63! Just one more step 
to go~!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... So you worked that hard for it, 
huh. In that case, butting in would just 
be in poor taste.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Then do it with your own two hands! If you 
pull that off, there's no doubt you'll be 
a model worth following!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Osu! Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, Trainer! I'm just down to my last 
good deed right now!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Still, I've spent all day helping people 
around school who were in trouble. I'm not 
sure if I can find... that last good deed 
to do.
choice_data_list:
Can "good deeds" only be performed if 
someone else is there?

Can "good deeds" only be done if there's 
someone on the receiving end?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...! Oh! You're totally right! Even if 
it's not helping someone specific, a good 
deed is still a good deed!
choice_data_list:
The answer lies in doing what you believe 
is cool.

The answer is to do what you yourself 
think is cool.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"What I think is cool... What's most 
fitting for a role model of Tracen 
Academy...!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh yeah, training! Some scorching-hot, 
fiery-blooded training!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOH! This is gonna be the last one! 
What kinda training should we cap it off 
with!?
choice_data_list: Work out as much as your heart desires!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOH! This is gonna be the last one! 
What kinda training should we cap it off 
with!?
choice_data_list: Work out as much as your heart desires!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Understood! I'm gonna pump up every 
single inch of my body~!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Hmph! ...Hunh hunh hunh hunh 
hunnnngh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Nearby Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah!? Wh-What incredible training...!! 
It's so intense that the school building 
is... shaking!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having safely achieved her goals, Bamboo 
Memory became a true role model for the 
students, both in name and in deed.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Alright! I'm gonna show everyone an 
awesome run that'll make me a model 
student for the whole academy!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa~!! For the finale, 64 laps around 
the track at full throttleee!!!!

text_block_list.name: Nearby Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
W-What a fiery run...! All right, we can't 
let ourselves lose either!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... I gave it everything I 
had...! I didn't lose to the students who 
kept up, all the way to the end!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having safely achieved her goals, Bamboo 
Memory became a true role model for the 
students, both in name and in deed.
